title: Bubba's Food
description: A pack that adds on to (or remakes) almost every edible item in minecraft.
body:
Ever feel that food looks bland? Almost inedible?
Well, try out Bubba's Food, which retextures most (if not, all) food to make it look tasty!

I first felt like the food in minecraft was pale-uninteresting. So, I decided to create this pack for everyone to enjoy their tasty (good looking) food.

You can also check out the gallery to see some of the new food,

So, if you want your food to look more interesting, download this pack and try it out.
